expectedRealization.rationale: Structural memory shortages can keep estimates moving for multiple quarters, but after a rapid price rerating the selection question is whether incremental earnings can still outrun absorbed expectations.

changeHypothesis.summary: Q2 evidence strengthened the memory shortage from cyclical to structural, and 兆易创新 had already delivered extraordinary Q1 earnings plus a >3x 2026 forecast reset. However, by the Q2 event's first frozen discovery date, the stock had already rerated sharply toward its 52-week high, so the new information did not leave a clean price-relative burden.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: TrendForce described persistent server-memory deficits and later mature-memory shortages with no visible near-term capacity relief.
disconfirmingEvidence: All Q2 industry discovery items share one specialist origin.

aShareCandidates.verifiedExposure: Q1 memory revenue RMB1.018bn +53.63%; company Q1 profit +332%; 2026E forecast was more than doubled.

earningsSensitivity.base: Strong memory-cycle exposure and forecast reset.
earningsSensitivity.favorable: DRAM price/margin realization exceeds post-Q1 baseline.
earningsSensitivity.adverse: Supply constraints cap volumes or high valuation absorbs upside.

matchedControls.name: 北京君正
matchedControls.fairCounterfactualReason: Direct non-STAR A-share memory-design peer with Q1 realized earnings acceleration and its own major forecast reset.
matchedControls.whySelectedCompanyShouldOutperform: 兆易创新 had a larger realized revenue/profit acceleration and stronger cash conversion, but the price-relative edge became mixed after its May rerating.

selectedDisadvantages: 兆易创新 price had already rerated sharply by May29
北京君正 also had a very large forecast reset and direct DRAM exposure
price-relative valuation edge was no longer clearly favorable
pairwise.switchCondition: Prefer 北京君正 or No selection if 兆易创新's incremental forecast revisions no longer exceed its higher absorbed valuation burden.

selectionComparison.rationale: Fundamental acceleration favors 兆易创新, but at the actual Q2 discovery cutoff the large intervening price rerating destroys a clear cross-sectional price-relative edge.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The Q1 earnings reset was already public for about a month. The May1 report raised 2026E profit from RMB2.07bn to RMB6.62bn at a 32.7x PE reference; by May29 the stock closed at RMB467.01 near a recent 52-week high.
expectations.thesisExpectation: The structural shortage may sustain further earnings upgrades, but the stock must deliver another meaningful reset to outrun the already-absorbed Q1 surprise.
expectations.measurableGap: Using the unchanged May1 EPS forecast as a simple burden reference, the May29 price implies roughly a high-40s/around-50x 2026E PE instead of the original 32.7x reference, showing substantial price absorption.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Forward-earnings burden updated for price absorption plus peer reset comparison.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: Post-Q1 2026E profit had already been reset to RMB6.62bn from RMB2.07bn; the stock then rerated sharply before the Q2 structural-shortage event was frozen.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Structural shortage persists long enough to drive another material earnings-estimate increase beyond the already-tripled post-Q1 forecast.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: Further earnings revisions must be large enough to offset the May price rerating and restore a clear relative valuation/earnings edge versus 北京君正.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: The industry thesis remains correct and earnings stay strong, but price had already capitalized the reset so the stock fails to generate selection alpha.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Subsequent contract-price data and Q2 earnings could confirm another reset, but the burden is already high.

fundamentalAcceleration.rationale: Q1 revenue/profit/cash flow and the external shortage evidence show exceptional acceleration.

realizedCompanyConfirmation.rationale: The company had already realized the industry up-cycle in Q1 financials.

crossSectionalConfirmation.rationale: 兆易创新's realized acceleration was stronger than 北京君正, but both had meaningful memory-cycle resets.

baselineLag.rationale: The May1 report explicitly recorded a prior 2026 forecast RMB2.07bn and reset it to RMB6.62bn.

priceAbsorption.checkMethod: Compare the May29 close/52-week position with the Apr29 price basis used in the post-Q1 forecast-reset report.
